text:
Nina: Kicking off a lightweight sweep idea for our least-privilege push 1: combine KMS grant/change events + service-account "last_used" + RBAC bindings to rank candidates for entitlement cleanup. Low friction pilot, monthly cadence.
Victor: Love that. Can we restrict to roles that actually allow kms:Decrypt or project-level admin rights so we don't spam reviewers?
Nina: Yes we'll filter policy bindings to roles that include kms.decrypt or roles/owner, roles/editor, roles/kms.admin. Also plan to tag any principals that appear in CI logs.
Leah: How are we detecting CI principals? Heuristics or allowlist? We should avoid breaking deploys.
Nina: Heuristics: user agent patterns (e.g., "terraform", "github-actions"), keys older than 90d with no recent oauth token rotation, and no associated human owner in the ownership map => mark as CI. Those go to "mitigation" workflow not immediate revoke.
Jordan: Audit question: how far back can we query KMS logs in prod? Need to surface if history is incomplete so reviewers don't assume inactivity.
Victor: Prod has 365d for KMS audit logs. Non-prod varies; sandbox projects may only have 30d retention. We'll include a retention_flag column in exports.
Leah: Redaction is required. For initial reviewer queues, mask emails and replace with stable principal IDs + hashed suffix. Ownership claims can reveal identity later.
Nina: Implementation sketch:
```
# get grant/decrypt events
gcloud logging read '\n protoPayload.methodName:("SetIamPolicy" OR "CreateGrant" OR "Decrypt")' --freshness=90d --format=json --project=redwood-prod
```
Nina: Join on principal -> bigquery table of service account token last_used -> compute score = weighted(last_used_age, number_of_grants, privileged_role_score, audit_history_availability). Sort desc and cap to 200 for manual review.
audit-bot: I can ingest CSV with columns (principal_id,project,flags) and return a reviewer bundle with links: rotation runbook, attestation template, and prefilled GH/JIRA issue. Drop to /tmp/entitlement-bundle.
Jordan: For CI principals marked "mitigation", attach a checklist: rotate key, rotate token, test on staging, rebind minimal roles. Provide rollback steps if rotation breaks.
Leah: Also suggest we add a column for "cross-project grants" because cross-account bindings complicate removal. Mark them as higher touch.
Nina: Agreed. Action list: 1) I'll prod the initial query + redaction pipeline and push a PR to infra-reports by Fri EOD. 2) Victor will bake in an audit_retention flag per project. 3) Leah to write the CI mitigation checklist and quick rotation commands. 4) Jordan to add cross-project grant detection and escalate labeling.
Victor: Quick callout we should log reviewer decisions back to the attestation table (who reviewed, decision, evidence link) for audit trail. Output format should be ingestable by compliance reports.
Leah: I'll include required evidence fields in the reviewer template. Minimal: justification, linked deploy run id (if CI), and evidence of rotation if changed.
Nina: Goal for pilot: <200 manual items and <10 false positives (where we flagged infra that then required emergency revert). If that looks OK after two runs we'll expand to monthly across all prod projects.
Jordan: Sounds good. I'll mock the export schema and share in #eng-devex for feedback on reviewer UX.
Leah: Dropping the rotation snippets here later; will include `gcloud iam service-accounts keys create|delete` examples and a sample script to atomically swap keys.
Nina: Thanks team. I'll follow up with the CSV and request reviewers next week. :thumbsup:
